limits: Labels include documented aliases and controller revisions, not a count of independent IC designs.
Exact modules, initialization and waveforms remain separate even when controller labels match.
Unidentified Spectra/ACeP controllers are represented by their exact panel profiles, not invented IC names.
Coverage means implemented driver/profile paths; tests and SDK results are separately recorded. No physical qualification is implied.
Board-specific raw-parallel EPDiy/Inkplate ecosystems are outside this generic SPI comparison.
